thread:
Maya Patel: CI alert - several quantized Llama-3 eval jobs failing to start, hitting a loader assert: checksum mismatch. I reproduced in the runner container locally.

Samir Kaur: paste the error snippet and which image tag CI used?

Maya Patel: log:
```
ERROR runner.loader: AssertionError: checkpoint hash mismatch (expected abcdef1234 got 9f8e7d6c32)
  File \"/opt/runner/loader.py\", line 128, in load_ckpt
    assert meta['checksum'] == expected_checksum
```
Container label shows `runner-converter:2.1.0`.

Lucas Nguyen: that sounds like the converter serialization changed. We flipped some defaults for q8 kernels last week which may affect ordering/metadata. Did infra promote a new converter image?

Toni Morales: yes, infra rolled the shared CI image set to include runner-converter:2.1.0 at ~03:30 UTC yesterday.
DeployBot: shared-ci-images: runner-converter:2.0.3 -> runner-converter:2.1.0

EvalBot: regression-alert: eval-suite/perplexity +8% on quant configs; 12% startup failures due to loader errors. Report: /reports/eval-2026-03-20-09

Samir Kaur: starting a bisect between converter v2.0.3 and v2.1.0. Using a minimal loader test inside the container to check checkpoint acceptance.
Command:
```
git bisect start 2.0.3 2.1.0
# run in CI image
docker run --rm runner-converter:$TAG /opt/runner/tools/check_ckpt.sh /models/llama3/q8/checkpoint
```

Maya Patel: We should gate the quant rollout. Can infra pin CI back to 2.0.3 or we fallback to unquantized artifacts until this is sorted? This blocks the release.

Lucas Nguyen: quick compatibility shim in the runner might buy us time: try legacy metadata keys and accept salted or unsalted checksum by stripping known build-id suffix. Minimal change and feature-flag it.

Samir Kaur: bisect found the commit: `abc123ef` (PR #3501, model-converter). It switched serialization to protobuf v2 and started salting checksum with build-id. Reproducer: converter v2.1.0 writes checksum as `<hash>-build.<id>` which fails legacy equality checks.

Toni Morales: marking as blocker. I'll open an infra rollback and hold the quant bring-up. INF-5823 created: "eval-runner: checkpoint checksum incompatibility from converter v2.1.0". Action items in ticket: rollback CI image (infra), short-term shim in runner (samir), or revert converter PR (converter owners).

Maya Patel: QA, please re-run the eval-suite after rollback and confirm all loaders initialize. Added QA Team to thread.

QA Team: Will run the full eval-suite on pinned converter:2.0.3 and report pass/fail matrix. ETA 2 hours.

Samir Kaur: I'll open a PR with a tolerant loader path and tests that accept salted checksums and log a deprecation warning. If converter team wants to revert, we'll coordinate.

Lucas Nguyen: FYI: also flag kernel ordering changes as a separate risk. Even if loader accepts salted checksums, binary layout changes could affect quantized inference numerics. We need to re-run key benchmarks post-rollback and post-fix.

Toni Morales: INF rollback in progress. Holding all quantized model deploys until we have a verified green. Will update once done.

Maya Patel: Thanks all. Marking thread as release-blocker for today's bring-up :thumbsup:
